title: Fifty five!
author: Fool on Hill
rules:
Puzzle rules

Normal Sudoku rules apply.

Box borders divide a blue region sum line Into segments with the same sum. (Different lines may have different sums)

Where two digits are separated by a black dot, one is double the other. Not all dots are necessarily given (partial kropki).

Digits in a cage sum to the total given in the top left corner.

I set this puzzle for Timotab's 55th birthday on 14 October - hence the clues. I was pretty pleased with the way it turned out. Enjoy!
